label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Sale of Goods Directive ((EU) 2019/771) - Article 10: Liability of the seller
6. Member States may provide that, in the case of second-hand goods, the seller and the consumer can agree to contractual terms or agreements with a shorter liability or limitation period than those referred to in paragraphs 1, 2 and 5, provided that such shorter periods shall not be less than one year.
raw_output: When a business sells used products, they can agree with customers on a shorter time limit for claims, but this limit must be at least one year. This applies during the sale of second-hand goods, involving the seller and the customer.
enrichment: When a business sells used products, they can agree with customers on a shorter time limit for claims, but this limit must be at least one year. This applies during the sale of second-hand goods, involving the seller and the customer.
